title: Dedicated autoscaling bounds + predictive scaling PRD signoff (open questions, approvals, launch criteria)
creator: Lauren Bishop
project: Autoscaling policies with customer bounds (Dedicated Capacity & Fleet Management)
content:
Goal
Drive final PRD review + signoff for Dedicated autoscaling bounds (min/max) + predictive signal blending, and align on GA launch criteria, defaults, and customer-facing semantics.

Primary doc for review
- Confluence PRD: sources/confluence/product-docs/requirements/autoscaling-bounds-predictive-prd.json
- Related design spec (Console + API surfaces): sources/confluence/product-docs/design-specs/dedicated-autoscaling-bounds-design-spec.json
- Semantics ADR: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-0142-autoscaling-bounds-semantics.json
- Predictive blending ADR: sources/confluence/architecture-and-standards/decision-records/adr-0143-predictive-signal-blending.json

Why now
Enterprise requests are consistently asking for strict spend controls + transparency:
- SUP-4821: autoscaler exceeded expected spend; explicit request for hard max + auditability
- Fireflies (NorthPeak): strict max-cap + predictable min floor are gating Dedicated purchase
We also have early signal that reactive-only scaling creates avoidable latency spikes during ramp (incident thread referenced by infra/SRE).

Decision summary (what PRD must lock)
1) Bounds semantics
- max_* is HARD: autoscaler must never apply > max (no exceptions)
- min_* is BEST-EFFORT during maintenance/drains + supply shortfalls, but should be treated as HARD in normal operation (no proactive scale-down below min)
- If min cannot be met (region shortage / drain), surface this clearly in internal + customer-visible events ("min_unavailable")

2) Predictive scaling is additive, gated by confidence
- Forecast may increase desired replicas within bounds
- Forecast must not decrease below what reactive signals would choose (unless bounded by max/min clamp behavior)
- Confidence gating + safety margin required; fallback to reactive-only on low confidence / stale forecast

3) Customer-facing UX commitments for GA
- Customers can set min/max (replicas or GPUs; final API naming to be confirmed by platform)
- Console shows scaling history with "why" fields including clamp_reason, signal summary, and config changes
- Provide guardrails/warnings when max is likely to throttle (copy + docs + sizing guidance)

Open questions to close for signoff
A) Field naming / units
- Control plane schema debate: min_gpus/max_gpus vs min_replicas/max_replicas.
  - Proposal: expose "min_replicas/max_replicas" in API for consistency; allow UI to label as GPUs when replica==GPU for pool type.
  - Owner: Ethan Park / Jordan Lee
  - PRD needs one choice for GA docs.

B) Multi-region pools
- Do bounds apply per-region or globally across the pool?
  - Current direction: bounds are per-region Dedicated pool allocation (simpler + aligns to actuation path).
  - If customer config includes multiple regions, we need explicit semantics + validation errors.
  - Owner: Mina Haddad + Ethan Park

C) Maintenance/drains behavior
- Confirm "best effort min" during drains is acceptable for contracts.
  - Need: contract language + Console messaging when min not met.
  - Owner: Lauren Bishop + Vanessa Ortiz + Sean Gallagher

D) Default bounds/backfill for existing pools
- Proposed default: set max = current configured ceiling (or observed historical peak + buffer) and min = current steady-state baseline.
- Risk: setting max too low causes throttling; setting max too high defeats spend-control promise.
- Need explicit defaulting + comms plan before migration is turned on.
  - Owner: Michael Nguyen + Rachel Kim + Elliot Price

E) Audit trail retention + export expectations
- GA: retention period for scaling events in Console (proposal: 14 days standard; 30/90 days add-on later)
- Capture config change actor (who/when) and evaluated policy snapshot.
  - Owner: Chloe Martin + Jada Williams + Marcus Lin

F) Predictive feature gating at GA
- Are predictive signals GA at the same time as bounds, or behind feature flag/advanced setting?
  - Proposed: bounds GA; predictive behind allowlist + "advanced settings" until we have 2–3 design partner results and stable false-positive rate.
  - Owner: Lauren Bishop + Keiko Yamamoto + Sean Gallagher

Signoff checklist (definition of "PRD approved")
- [x] Semantics locked: hard max, min behavior during drains/shortage, and clamp/audit requirements reflected in ADR-0142
- [x] Predictive blending approach documented in ADR-0143 with confidence gating + fallback
- [x] Control plane validation requirements listed (min<=max; region/hardware constraints)
- [x] Observability + SLO ownership aligned (alerts, SLIs, and who gets paged)
- [x] Console commitments reviewed (audit trail fields, filters, RBAC)
- [x] Rollout plan includes feature flags + allowlisting + rollback
- [x] Customer comms + docs plan drafted (bounds meaning, avoiding throttling, recommended defaults)

Launch criteria (GA for bounds)
Functional
- 0 bound violations (applied_replicas must never exceed configured max)
- No proactive scale-down below min (outside explicitly defined drain/maintenance exceptions)
- Control plane validation returns actionable error messages (incl. multi-region/hardware constraints)

Performance / reliability
- Scaling lag SLI: p95 time-to-scale-up after sustained demand increase < 4 minutes for supported regions/hardware (initial target; SRE to confirm)
- Oscillation guard: sustained oscillation rate below threshold (per SRE doc) with default cooldowns
- Predictive pipeline failures do not degrade below reactive baseline (graceful fallback)

Observability / auditability
- Metrics: desired_replicas, applied_replicas, clamp_reason, scale_latency, oscillation_counter (with cardinality controls)
- Console: Scaling History shows "why did we scale" (signal summary + clamp_reason) and config changes
- Support: runbook published + escalation checklist (incl. freeze scaling / pin replicas)

Rollout
- Feature flag present; allowlist by region + customer
- Dogfood (internal Dedicated pools) complete with no bound violations and acceptable scaling lag
- 2–3 design partners complete at least 2 weeks with: (a) no max overshoot incidents, (b) customer feedback on transparency, (c) documented sizing guidance

Notes / decisions captured during review
- We will not promise "hard min" in the presence of fleet shortage; instead we commit to (1) no deliberate scale-down below min and (2) explicit eventing + guidance when min cannot be satisfied.
- Predictive scaling will not be marketed as GA in the same release as bounds; it remains allowlisted until we hit stability thresholds (false positives / overnight overprovision incidents).
